name: steering-example

envVarDescriptions.EXAMPLE_API_BASE_URL: Base URL of the example API gateway this config bridges, no trailing slash (e.g. 'https://api.example.com') — substituted into baseUrl.

usage.setup: Example steering config — set EXAMPLE_API_BASE_URL to the base URL of the API gateway you are bridging. Copy and customize for your own API gateway.

description: Example 40mcp config showing how to configure agent steering on tools. Demonstrates forced-inference writes (steering.write) and prehook/posthook instruction injection. Stateless — the MCP server transforms each call independently.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Write a finding to persistent memory. Forced-inference: memory_type/confidence/importance are auto-injected as required fields.

steering.prehook: Classify this write before committing. memory_type=correction makes the entry permanent; hypothesis gets a 14-day half-life. Use importance=1.0 for anything that steers future behavior.

posthook.instructions: After the write lands, call mem_release on any related handles with outcome='persisted'. If memory_type=correction, also append it to the session chain with chain_append.

tools.name: ticket_create
tools.description: Open a support ticket. Prehook reminds the agent to capture context; posthook tells it to link the ticket to the current handle.

steering.prehook: Before opening a ticket, verify the issue is reproducible and include a minimal repro in the body.
steering.posthook: Now link the returned ticket_id to the current coordination handle via mem_release(handleId, outcome='escalated', note=ticket_id).

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Read-only search. No steering — searches don't mutate memory.
